law_name: Copyright and Related Rights Act (Law No. 23/2010), as amended by first amendment ratified 10 December 2024
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (extended from 50 years by the 2024 amendment; joint works from last surviving author)
fair_use_exceptions: Educational and research exceptions introduced by 2024 amendment (unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: Ministry of Economic Development and Trade (Maldives Intellectual Property Office under Act No. 13/2025) (unconfirmed)
notes: Berne in force 22 Nov 2025; WCT/WPPT not confirmed; amendment effective three months after gazette publication
